Arden Oak Desk Lamp

£89.00

The Arden is turned from a single piece of English oak and finished by hand with a hard-wax oil, so every base has its own grain. A linen shade softens the light for long evenings of reading.

It takes any E27 bulb up to 40 W, and the braided cable has an inline dimmer within easy reach of your chair.

Specifications

Height46 cm
Shade diameter28 cm
Cable2 m, braided, with dimmer
